children.nl_statement: Section 7, equations (7.1)--(7.5): the normalized exponential cone density satisfies the entropy theorem hypotheses; its entropy and covariance determinant have the stated exact formulas. Includes positivity of body volume and covariance determinant. The height is coordinate zero; no centering hypothesis is required, using a determinant-one shear.
children.role_in_glue: Supply an admissible log-concave density and convert both analytic conclusions into exact statements about ChallengeDeps.vol and covMatrix.

children.nl_statement: Section 7, equations (7.7)--(7.8) and converse: the exponential density on the cone over K is an invertible affine exponential product if and only if K is the convex hull of n+1 affinely independent vertices.
children.role_in_glue: Translate analytic equality into the exact frozen IsSimplex predicate, and prove the converse equality for every simplex.

notes: Follows the supplied paper: two analytic components of Theorem 1.2 and two independent Section 7 components. All new vocabulary is specified by explicit defining equations in each closed statement. The final real-power algebra stays in root helpers. The entropy developments should share the strict smooth remainder and approximation infrastructure; the equality child can work on Lemmas 6.1--6.2 before those helpers are available. Cone.moments uses an explicit determinant-one shear to avoid imposing a centroid-zero hypothesis.
